title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Claims Manual — Coverage Start and the Recognised Covered-Treatment Fee
content:
**Orthodontic Benefit Riders: when coverage of a new-start case begins, and the fee recognised for the treatment the rider covers.**

## When coverage of the case begins

A new-start case is covered when its banding date falls on or after the day its coverage begins.

- **The day coverage begins** is the first day of the month that is the net waiting months after the rider effective date.
- **The net waiting months** are the waiting months less every reduction that applies, never below zero.
- **Prior orthodontic coverage** recorded on the rider reduces the waiting months by one month for each documented month on a rider with month-for-month credit, and by nothing otherwise.
- Months are counted in calendar months, with the last day of the month used when the target day does not exist.

## Waiting months

The waiting months follow the Dental PPO Plans enrollment the rider is attached to:

- on a rider that covers adults, the rider's adult waiting months, when that enrollment is in the individual market and the patient had reached the 19th birthday on the banding date;
- none, when it is a group enrollment that did not enter as a late entrant;
- otherwise, the rider's child waiting months for an individual-market patient under 19, or the rider's late-entrant waiting months for a group late entrant.

## The fee

1. **Months of treatment before coverage.** The net waiting months, less the whole calendar months from the rider effective date to the banding date, less one for the month in which the appliances were placed, and never below zero.
2. **Months of treatment still to come when coverage begins.** The planned treatment months on the new-start entry, less the months of treatment before coverage, and never below zero. These are the covered months.
3. **Recognised covered-treatment fee.** The allowed case fee on the new-start entry, times the months of treatment still to come when coverage begins, divided by the planned treatment months, rounded half up to the cent.
4. A case with no planned treatment months, or a rider with no new-start entry, has a fee of zero.

## Fee of the practice now treating the patient

For a case that has moved, the fee of the practice now treating the patient is the lesser of:

- the allowed case fee; and
- the rate of the practice named on the latest transfer entry, which is its treatment fee on that entry divided by the months remaining on it and multiplied by the planned treatment months.

For any other case it is the allowed case fee. A case whose latest transfer entry has no months remaining is treated as a case that has not moved for this fee.

## Order of assembly

The recognised covered-treatment fee is assembled in one fixed order:

1. The covered months are counted and valued as stated.
2. Every share taken off the fee, and every part kept whole, is first set aside from that value, and the rest is divided by the planned treatment months.
3. Every part kept whole is then added back as its share of the fee of the practice now treating the patient.
4. Every amount to be subtracted is then subtracted.
5. The result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and is never below zero.

## Counting conventions

- Whole calendar months between two dates count a month only when the day of the month of the later date is on or after the day of the month of the earlier date. There is no special rule for the end of a month.
- The 19th birthday is reached once 228 such months have passed since the date of birth.
- The new-start entry is the latest establishment entry under the rider. When two establishment entries carry the same date, the one entered first counts as the latest.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

The inputs: an individual-market child rider with hypothetical waiting months of 12 and no prior orthodontic coverage, a rider effective date of 1 February, a banding date of 20 June the same year, 25 planned treatment months, and an allowed case fee of 4,940.00 on the new-start entry.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Coverage begins | 1 February of the following year; banding on 20 June is earlier |
| Whole months from 1 February to 20 June | 4 |
| Months before coverage | 12 less 4, less 1 for the banding month, is 7 |
| Months still to come when coverage begins | 25 less 7 is 18 |
| Recognised covered-treatment fee | 4,940.00 times 18, divided by 25, is 3,556.80 |
